summary: Silver Bow Mining Corp. filed an 8-K on August 24, 2026, providing webcast slides and script regarding its previously announced acquisition of the Jefferson County Metallurgical Complex. The company will seek shareholder approval to issue contingent value rights (CVRs) and underlying common shares in connection with the transaction. The filing serves as solicitation material; a proxy statement will be filed with the SEC. Terms such as price, premium, and expected close were not disclosed in this excerpt. The transaction remains subject to shareholder approval. Watch for proxy filing and shareholder vote results.
